svg.title: AWS architecture: EC2 frontend, web API and Python voice
svg.desc: CloudFront serves HTTPS from a Jakarta EC2 host running SvelteKit frontend and API plus Python voice. RDS and private S3 storage are in Jakarta. GitHub Actions checks both services, builds an ECR image and deploys it by digest through Systems Manager using OIDC.
svg.text: Solid: application traffic · Dashed: deployment & administration
